home.title: Texas, one map
home.subtitle: Live data from every suite app — same APIs as the full products. Toggle layers and open the real app from any pin.
home.hint: Turn on a layer chip to load that full-app API. Tap a pin for details.
home.pickLayers: All filters off — turn on a layer to load data
home.disclaimer: Map Hub proxies each product’s live API. If a source is offline, that layer falls back to demo pins until it recovers.

about.title: About Map Hub
about.body: Map Hub is the center of TxBizFinder Intelligence. It does not invent data — it calls the same backends each full app uses and plots them together.
about.layers: Finder → /api/leads · Radar → /api/permits · Channel → monitors/events · Sentinel → /v1/facilities · Flood → /api/risk/zones · Power → /api/grid/regions.
about.suite: Sister apps: TxBizFinder, PermitRadar, ChannelWatch, Emissions Sentinel, FloodGuard Texas, PowerPulse Texas.
